## Summary

- what changed
- why it changed

## Change Type

- new pattern
- metadata update
- hazards / caveats
- fixtures
- validator / tooling
- docs
- promotion request

## Target Lane

- validated
- working-set
- deferred

## Checklist

- [ ] I placed the pattern in the intended lane
- [ ] I added or updated required metadata
- [ ] I documented hazards or caveats where relevant
- [ ] I included fixtures or examples where possible
- [ ] I explained why this pivot is useful
- [ ] I included promotion rationale if this changes `validation_state` or moves a pattern between lanes
- [ ] I considered portability and called out domain- or environment-specific assumptions
- [ ] I am not using `validated` to mean attribution, maliciousness, runtime confidence, or final assessment
- [ ] I signed off my contributor-authored commits, or I confirm DCO acceptance here and understand a maintainer may squash/clean up the contribution before merge
- [ ] I disclosed any relevant affiliation, financial interest, proprietary-data dependency, product interest, or vendor relationship that could affect review; routine neutral fixes may mark this as not applicable
